title: Stasis Ritualis
description: A multi-armed skeletal beetle deity with golden halos and horns sits atop a mound of beetles and flames, holding a staff, incense burner, and other objects. To the right, a robed female figure with golden rings around her head and body extends her hand, dripping liquid toward the ritual scene.
prompt: Detailed black and white ink illustration with selective gold accents on an off-white textured background. A six-armed skeletal scarab beetle god with large horns and multiple golden halos sits atop a mound of writhing beetles and ritual flames. The deity holds a staff, incense burner, and other objects. To the right stands a robed woman with long hair, her head and torso encircled by glowing golden rings, extending her hand with dripping liquid. Text 'STASIS RITUALIS' in the upper right corner, mystical occult atmosphere with floating orbs and smoke.
